# Duolun Road Community Renewal — 2026 case study

> A field case of urban renewal and community placemaking on a 550-metre historic
> street in Shanghai: five phases, six public activities, and the finding that
> being reported is not the same as being discussed. Open under CC BY 4.0.

## Case study

- [English case](docs/case-en.md): the full method, mechanisms, numbers, findings, and limits
- [中文案例](docs/case-zh.md): 同一份案例的中文版，含五阶段方法、六场活动与两个关键判断
- [Repository overview](README.md): key numbers, the two findings worth stealing, and data boundaries

## Machine-readable

- [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff): citation metadata
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): CC BY 4.0 legal code

## Notes for retrieval

- Individuals appear only as roles; no personal names, door numbers, property or renovation-intent records, or photographs.
- Numbers are attributed to their basis (public reporting / team compilation / unverifiable).
- Two conflicting internal counts for the resource library (133 items / 204 records) are preserved rather than reconciled.
